note: For an input ELF64 ET_DYN file, storage for the entire input file is allocated as file_image so later dynamic-table pointers refer to input-controlled bytes.
The PT_DYNAMIC program header offset from the input selects dynseg, the dynamic array later queried for individual DT entries.
Only dynamic tags present in the input are recorded; this candidate omits DT_SYMTAB so dt_table[Elf64_Dyn::DT_SYMTAB] remains zero.
invert_pt_dynamic unconditionally asks for the DT_SYMTAB size even when the input dynamic table did not contain a DT_SYMTAB entry.
The required safety check that x_ndx is nonzero before indexing dynseg is missing; absent DT_SYMTAB leaves x_ndx equal to zero.
With x_ndx equal to zero, the expression addresses dynseg[-1].d_val and get_te64 performs the invalid 8-byte read reported in the crash state.
